subject: Mutual Action Plan: performance test window, ops owners & sizing confirmation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@cloudledger.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP milestone: performance test window options & next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the MAP milestone for the performance/load test on paper:

- Objective: run a traffic replay test that simulates your peak QPS (target: 7k sustained QPS peak with 95th percentile latencies under 200ms for API gen endpoints).
- Candidate windows: Aug 9–10 (preferred) or Aug 16–17 (backup) — both are US-Pacific friendly.
- Redwood responsibilities: provide dedicated capacity reservation (estimated 8x A100-equivalent GPU pool), prepare traffic replay harness, and run the test with monitoring dashboards and token/cost estimates.
- CloudLedger responsibilities: provide traffic replay manifests (sample event stream), confirm data redaction rules, approve service account for test cluster access, and be available for a 2-hour incident window during the test for troubleshooting.
- Dependencies: final manifest + approval of test user accounts at least 72 hours before the window; procurement confirmation for dedicated capacity if you'd like a reserved pool.
- Target MAP milestone close: Aug 18, 2027 (test executed + joint results review) — tentative and can shift based on procurement timelines.

Attached: initial traffic_replay_manifest.csv (sample), MAP draft (map_draft-v2.pdf).

Can you confirm the preferred window and whether you can deliver the manifest and approve service accounts by Aug 6? If procurement is needed for a dedicated pool, please flag and we can escalate to procurement/sales for a reservation.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
(priorities: MAP milestone ownership + test coordination)

(attachment: traffic_replay_manifest.csv)
(attachment: map_draft-v2.pdf)

From: Sarah Liu <sarah@cloudledger.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
Cc: CloudLedger Infra <infraops@cloudledger.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP milestone: performance test window options & next steps

Priyom —

Appreciate the clear recap. Aug 9–10 would work best for our SRE team. A few clarifications before we lock anything: 

1) Peak QPS: 7k sustained is in the ballpark, but we expect momentary spikes to ~9k for <60s. Can Redwood accomodate spike handling or do we need a buffer in the sizing?
2) Data handling: we'll redact PII client identifiers — I’ll attach a redaction spec. We also need an explicit list of APIs/endpoints you will hit with the replay.
3) Service accounts: infraops can create the service account if you provide the IAM role list.
4) Procurement: we have a standing cloud budget for proofs, but dedicated GPU reservations will need a PO. Will you share estimated costs for the reserved pool ASAP?

We will aim to deliver the full manifest and IAM list by Aug 4. That should meet the 72-hour cutoff if Aug 9 is the go date.

Attaching: CL-redaction-spec.pdf (small).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Liu
Director, Platform Engineering, CloudLedger Inc.

(attachment: CL-redaction-spec.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>, Sarah Liu <sarah@cloudledger.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP milestone: performance test window options & next steps

Thanks — quick technical responses so procurement and infra have what they need: 

- Spike handling: our serving runtime supports autoscaling with graceful degradation; for a test that includes 9k momentary spikes we recommend sizing for sustained 7k and enabling burst capacity with warm standby nodes to cover spikes. Practically, that maps to a reserved pool equivalent to 8 A100s + 2 warm standby units (quantized/V100-equivalent nodes if needed); cost/throughput numbers in the attached estimator (performance-test-plan.xlsx).
- Endpoints: we'll run the traffic_replay against the published API surface: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, and embedding endpoints depending on manifest flags. If you want a narrower scope please confirm — narrower = lower cost and faster test.
- IAM roles: we need a service account with these roles: redwood-test-access (scoped), logs:write, metrics:read. If infraops can create it and send the key to the secure upload link, that works.

Action items I can take: finalize capacity reservation once procurement approval is confirmed; coordinate a pre-test dry-run (30–60 minutes) two days before the full window; run the full replay and produce the joint results pack within 24 hours of test completion.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference

(attachment: performance-test-plan.xlsx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.example>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@cloudledger.com>, CloudLedger Infra <infraops@cloudledger.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + MAP milestone: performance test window options & next steps

Great — thanks everyone for the quick replies. Finalizing the MAP milestone here so we can mark responsibilities and target dates: 

- Agreed test window: Aug 9–10, 2027 (primary). Pre-test dry-run: Aug 7 (30–60 minutes).
- Redwood (owner: Priyom / tech lead: Karthik): reserve dedicated capacity (8 A100-equivalent + 2 warm standby), deploy replay harness, run dry-run and full replay, provide monitoring dashboard and a results pack within 24 hours.
- CloudLedger (owner: Sarah / infra owner: infraops): deliver final traffic_replay_manifest.csv and IAM service account by Aug 4; confirm redaction spec and endpoints by Aug 4; provide PO or go-ahead for reserved capacity by Aug 5 if you want a guaranteed pool.
- Dependencies & risks: procurement delay will push the test to Aug 16–17 fallback. If manifests come in late we may run a scoped replay limited to /v1/generate.
- MAP milestone target: Aug 18, 2027 — successful test + joint results review.

Next steps: Sarah to confirm receipt of this message; Infra to share IAM role object or upload key to the secure link (https://secure-upload.redwood.example/upload/CL-RED-114). Redwood will start cost estimate paperwork and send a reserved-pool quote by end of day Jul 29.

I’ll add this as a MAP milestone in the HubSpot deal and attach the files we referenced.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.
Priyom
